## Line 111

```plato

    // Whether every loop chains end-to-start into a closed cycle.
    // Precondition: LoopUsesInRange and EdgesInRange hold.
    LoopsConnected(b: Brep3D): Boolean
        => b.Faces.All(f => f.Loops.All(l =>
            MapRange(l.Uses.Count, i =>
                b.EndVertex(l.Uses[i]).Value
                    == b.StartVertex(l.Uses[(i + 1) % l.Uses.Count]).Value)
                .All(ok => ok)));
```
